description_en: Binds multiple real numbers to a service instance at a time

kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi add-virtual-number-relation --prod-code dyvms --corp-name-list '公司1,公司2' --number-list 13211110000,13222220000 --route-type 0 --phone-num 055162140000 --region cn-hangzhou
